name: Katsuki Sayu
source:
"Gods? There's no way things like that exist..."

Her parents used to live in the neighborhood near the Haruki Shrine, but after they died she moved into an apartment near her academy with her older brother.
She's supposed to be in charge of the cooking, laundry, and other household chores, but her brother does most of it.
She was a tomboy when she was younger but she started acting more bright after her parent's died in order not to worry her brother.
She's lost her memories of her childhood, but she doesn't think much of it and thinks that it's just regular fading with time.
She is sociable and has many friends, but she finds it hard to show her true feeling to people. She doesn't have much interest in love and she has never had a boyfriend.
Neither studying nor moving her body are her strong point, she's an average girl with no strong or weak points.
She wants to hurry up and become independent so she works part time at the Haruki Shrine.

She's a realist who doesn't believe in things like gods, but then she met the self styled 'god' Ren.
After learning that her childhood memories were sealed along with Ren's god powers she only half believed it, but she feels something strange when she's with him, so she starts to search for her missing memories along with him.
